title: JSON Web Token: one-property twin (alphabet) (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: one character (+) outside the RFC 7519 base64url alphabet. Twin of "JSON Web Token: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
